definitions.explanation: The area or boundaries within which something operates, exists, or applies.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えてください→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the scope of the test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選|えら}んでください→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Please choose within the budget limits.
examples.notes: 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ = within the limits of ~

examples.japanese: ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The scope of the impact is expanding.

notes:
USAGE: {範囲|はんい} indicates boundaries, limits, or the extent of something. Very common in academic, business, and everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい} (the scope/range of ~)
・⟦{範囲|はんい}{内|ない}→範囲内：25429_haninai⟧ (within the range)
・⟦{範囲|はんい}{外|がい}→範囲外：28213_hanigai⟧ (outside the range)
・{範囲|はんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to expand the scope)
・{範囲|はんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧ (to limit the scope)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい} (test coverage)
・⟦{権限|けんげん}→権限：10600_kengen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい} (scope of authority)
・⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい} (budget limits)
・⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲|はんい} (within one's ability)
・⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{範囲|はんい} (wide range)
